item.title: Sábado de Tech: Why the Sun pulled NASA's Swift telescope out of orbit
item.description:
The space station finishes its solar upgrade · Apple puts its engineers on an AI budget · OpenAI's security-hunting model · A supermoon on the calendar · Why the Sun pulled down NASA's Swift telescope · Sandia: aiming at a lumpy asteroid · Does the supermoon cause earthquakes? · Do solar panels work when it's cloudy?
